verdict.rationale: Jan runs GGUF models via llama.cpp (jan-docs-6, jan-docs-10), and GGUF format inherently supports a range of integer quantization levels, implying the capability exists, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents quantization options, bit-level selection, or memory-footprint controls for power-users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported quant levels (e.g., Q2_K–Q8_0), UI for choosing quantization at download/import, and any hands-on confirmation of memory savings.
